experiment.headline: For Moments That Matter
experiment.body: Wishing you strength and peace on your day.

grades.label: Mode A - current overlay
grades.bestPanel: Front cover has exact deterministic headline/body and a strong charcoal/gold premium look.
grades.worstPanel: The background model output includes fake readable lettering under the overlay, visible as LAVE.
blockingFailures: Background fake text makes the design unsafe for direct production without retouching.
grades.promptChange: Strengthen the artwork-only negative prompt and reserve a larger no-lettering central text field.
grades.modelChange: This is partly model capability: DeepAI still introduced fake letters despite no-text instructions.
grades.costQualityCall: Acceptable as a fallback, but Mode C gives a cleaner result at the same provider cost.

grades.label: Mode B - full AI typography
grades.hardFailureCap: Cap at 55 because generated text is prominent and materially misspelled.
grades.bestPanel: The model selected a coherent sunburst/card composition with a usable broad hierarchy.
grades.worstPanel: The requested headline/body were corrupted into misspelled text, including Fo'r ments and incorrect body wording.
blockingFailures: Body copy changes meaning and contains misspellings.
grades.promptChange: Do not use full AI typography for final customer panels with required copy.
grades.modelChange: This is a model capability failure for exact typographic rendering, not just prompt wording.
grades.costQualityCall: Not worth the same provider call for production output; keep only for exploratory concept art if needed.

grades.label: Mode C - hybrid reserved layout
grades.bestPanel: The generated artwork reserves clean central space and the deterministic renderer keeps all copy exact.
grades.worstPanel: The composition is polished but still generic; a customer-specific motif would raise usefulness.
grades.promptChange: Make the hybrid reserved-layout contract the default for card panels that contain required text.
grades.modelChange: No model change required for this provider path; the app renderer should continue owning exact typography.
grades.costQualityCall: Best quality per call in this experiment because it avoids retouching and preserves exact copy.

productionRecommendation: Adopt Mode C for final card panels with required text. Keep Mode A as a fallback only if the generated artwork is screened for fake lettering. Exclude Mode B from production generation unless a future image model passes exact typography tests.
